explanation: No symbol dimensions, vertex counts, document names, coordinates or gold counts are used in these code paths. Count eligibility follows explicit IFC aggregation relationships; footprints use the existing IfcOpenShell projected mesh union.

net_area_relative_difference.provenance: Our area-comparison policy, not a fitted dataset threshold or a buildingSMART requirement.

policies.length_to_m: Declared IFC project length unit; geometry API returns SI metres by default.
policies.area_to_m2: Explicit quantity/property area unit, otherwise declared IFC project area unit, independently of the length unit.

confidence_caps.interpretation: Conservative display caps consistent with existing app confidence bands; not measured accuracy probabilities.

policies.room_area_basis: Explicit gross and unqualified scalar floor totals use gross Qto where available. Named-room areas and net breakdowns retain declared net quantities when a footprint matches gross Qto but disagrees with net Qto. Explicit net measurements use footprints unless the geometry is identified as gross extent; missing gross/net quantities use available footprints. No document-specific branch is used.
